name: record-fetch-subject
description: Setup command for a subject-scoped wrapper: resolves the card's prerequisites on every session of the subject (XNW_PREREQ_*, PROC_SUBJECT_ID) and materialises them under prereq/<name>/<session label>/ in its mount. Runs record-fetch --no-passthrough: the mount is the project archive (a Subject cannot feed a mount), which must not be copied through. A missing prerequisite fails the run before any compute.
